reference_policy: one target image per grooming edit; approved sample is visual QC reference, not an extra input that may change markings
notes: Preserve white chest/belly, eyebrows, muzzle, paws, tail-tip and black upper coat.
Back-view images must remain back-facing; only preserve visible markings, do not invent hidden face/chest.
Preserve original pose, muzzle/ear/eye geometry, outfit and landscape.
Different props/background changes need explicit scene-specific brief and separate review.
No automatic video regeneration or visual acceptance.
